title: The open count includes Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, Complete
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A technician with a known mix of work orders across statuses so the expected N can be computed by hand.
custom_steps:
1. Count by hand the technician's work orders in Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review and Complete.
  2. Open the Reassign dialog and read the technician's N open figure.
  3. Confirm N equals your hand count, so Estimate, Invoiced and Paid work orders are not counted.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Reassign lead technician dialog's "N open" count includes Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, and Complete work orders.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S4-R15 (read 30 Sep 2026).
